summary: Causal intervention on top-5 bump directions per block from cycle 235 T1. Inject alpha*std_l_i*v_l_i into residual stream entering next block; compare logit shifts to random-direction baseline and Jaccard vs T1 predicted boost list.
strengths: Cleanly reuses cycle 235 artifacts (V_l, mean_delta_l, coherent counts).
std_l recomputed with identical calibration loader (same seed/N_SEQS/SEQ_LEN) — fair.
Held-out batch explicitly DISJOINT from calibration (val vs train).
Sanity checks appropriate: alpha=0 no-op, linearity (l2_a1<=l2_a3), std_l finiteness, coherent-count cross-check.
Verdict bands (confirmed/refuted/inconclusive) match item 246 hypothesis verbatim.
Concrete fallbacks for wall-time, file size, and std_l failure modes.

concerns.text: Hook target for block 11: no h[12] exists. Plan correctly uses forward_pre_hook on transformer.ln_f for l=11. Handled.
forward_pre_hook on h[l+1] receives args[0] = residual stream before block l+1's LN_1, which IS 'after block l'. Correct injection point.

Random baseline MUST rescale unit-norm Gaussian v_rand by mean(std_l) (plan step 6 says so). Without rescale, effect_size is inflated ~5-10x and 3x threshold is trivially passed. Code review: assert rescale is applied.
Effect size normalization (step 7) divides by random_l2_mean_alpha_3[l]. Correctness depends on concern 3 being handled.
T1 top_vocab_boost field type: verify list-of-ids vs list-of-dicts when loading decoded.json; extract token_id only for Jaccard set.
logit_shifts.pt size: mean_shift only ~60MB; top1000 adds ~2.4MB — negligible, keep.
alpha=0 correctly skips hook registration and uses logits_clean. Good.

minor_notes: Example records use char-level context truncation (last 50 chars) — fine for rendering.
std_l_i stored per entry in intervention.json — good for reproducibility.
Suggest logging n_hits[l] and max_effect_size[l] in summary.md even on INCONCLUSIVE.
notes: Concerns 3-5 are code-review items for execute agent, not plan defects. Plan is self-contained, deps satisfied (cycle 235 DONE), verdict bands concrete, fallbacks specific.
